import pytest

from tinydb import TinyDB
from tinydb.storages import MemoryStorage


def test_ac1_pop_returns_and_removes_document() -> None:
    db = TinyDB(storage=MemoryStorage)
    db.insert({'x': 1})
    assert db.table('_default').pop(1) == {'x': 1}
    assert len(db) == 0


def test_ac2_pop_missing_id_raises_keyerror() -> None:
    db = TinyDB(storage=MemoryStorage)
    with pytest.raises(KeyError):
        db.table('_default').pop(99)
